guide.evolvedwarfare.cities.name: Cities and trade
guide.evolvedwarfare.cities.left.title: Cities
guide.evolvedwarfare.cities.left.1: Medieval, desert and northern cities, with traders and recruits.
guide.evolvedwarfare.cities.left.2: They have a level from 1 to 10: the farther from spawn, the higher.
guide.evolvedwarfare.cities.left.3: Higher level: better quality goods, but pricier.
guide.evolvedwarfare.cities.right.title: Trade
guide.evolvedwarfare.cities.right.1: Everything is paid in Glory Coins: sell to traders or find them in chests.
guide.evolvedwarfare.cities.right.2: The Glory Pouch holds all your coins in a single slot.
guide.evolvedwarfare.cities.right.3: Crops, meat and fish only sell in full Produce Crates.
guide.evolvedwarfare.people.name: Your people
guide.evolvedwarfare.people.left.title: Recruits
guide.evolvedwarfare.people.left.1: They live in cities, camps and towers. Hire them with a Contract.
guide.evolvedwarfare.people.left.2: They get paid daily (food or coins). After 3 unpaid days, they leave.
guide.evolvedwarfare.people.left.3: A weapon and Train make a soldier. The Command Staff leads them.
guide.evolvedwarfare.people.right.title: Your town
guide.evolvedwarfare.people.right.1: Place a work post and Assign a recruit: they work on their own.
guide.evolvedwarfare.people.right.2: The Town Hall feeds your people nearby.
guide.evolvedwarfare.people.right.3: The Warehouse links your chests; the courier carries things.
guide.evolvedwarfare.war.name: Factions and war
guide.evolvedwarfare.war.left.title: Factions
guide.evolvedwarfare.war.left.1: Bandits, vikings and pirates live in settlements of level 1 to 10.
guide.evolvedwarfare.war.left.2: Your reputation decides if they attack. The White Flag lets you talk.
guide.evolvedwarfare.war.left.3: They raid towns, and every 7 days (red day) a horde attacks.
guide.evolvedwarfare.war.right.title: Weapons and siege
guide.evolvedwarfare.war.right.1: Medieval weapons, each with its own strike. Headshots hurt more.
guide.evolvedwarfare.war.right.2: Musket: right-click aims, left-click fires, R reloads.
guide.evolvedwarfare.war.right.3: Catapult, ballista, trebuchet and ram: get on and look at the target.
guide.evolvedwarfare.skills.name: Skills
guide.evolvedwarfare.skills.left.title: Skills
guide.evolvedwarfare.skills.left.1: 11 skills that rise as you use them: weapons, shield, armor, command…
guide.evolvedwarfare.skills.left.2: Leveling them levels you up. Each level gives 1 perk point.
guide.evolvedwarfare.skills.left.3: Press K (or use the Research Desk): your tree.
guide.evolvedwarfare.skills.right.title: Perks
guide.evolvedwarfare.skills.right.1: Spend points on perks: more damage, crits, better soldiers…
guide.evolvedwarfare.skills.right.2: Forge perks let you craft the mod's weapons and machines.
message.evolvedwarfare.guide.given: You have the Evolved Warfare Guide in your inventory: right-click to read it.

perk.evolvedwarfare.faction_tailor.desc: You can craft the rank 1 and 2 faction armors (outlaw, highwayman, hunter, warrior, deckhand and buccaneer).

message.evolvedwarfare.city_guard.hello: "Keep the peace in our city, stranger." (With a contract and 15 Glory Coins they'd leave their post for you.)

message.evolvedwarfare.city_law.forgiven: The guards of %s no longer hunt you.

message.evolvedwarfare.season.start.summ: Summer begins: hot days; beware of heatstroke.

message.evolvedwarfare.season.start.wint: Winter begins: snow, ice, and outdoor crops barely grow. Dress warmly.

gui.evolvedwarfare.catalog.blurb.1: Recommended by ranchers and trappers all over the frontier.
gui.evolvedwarfare.catalog.blurb.2: A bargain without equal! Ask for it in any town.
gui.evolvedwarfare.catalog.blurb.3: Made to last. No house in the land offers it better.
gui.evolvedwarfare.catalog.blurb.4: A must in every decent home and every caravan.

gui.evolvedwarfare.catalog.blurb.sell: This house pays cash, no haggling.
item.evolvedwarfare.boiled_water.desc: Parasite-free water: boil a water bottle in a furnace or on a campfire, or fill it from a cauldron over a fire.
item.evolvedwarfare.melon_juice.desc: Quenches a lot of thirst and cools you down. A bottle and three melon slices.
item.evolvedwarfare.apple_juice.desc: Quenches thirst and feeds a little. A bottle and two apples.
item.evolvedwarfare.berry_juice.desc: Quenches thirst. A bottle and four sweet berries.
item.evolvedwarfare.canteen.desc.empty: Four sips of water. Right-click water to fill it (or a cauldron over a fire: boiled).
item.evolvedwarfare.canteen.desc.raw: Unboiled: it may carry parasites. Boil it in a furnace or on a campfire.
item.evolvedwarfare.canteen.desc.boiled: Boiled water, safe. Refilling it from a river makes it unboiled again.
message.evolvedwarfare.thirst.parasites: You caught parasites: the water was not boiled (milk cures you)
death.attack.evolvedwarfare.parasites.pl: %1$s was killed by parasites whilst fleeing %2$s
config.evolvedwarfare.thirstEnabled.tip: Thirst and its meter above the hunger bar: you have to drink water (preferably boiled).
config.evolvedwarfare.parasiteChance.tip: Chance of catching parasites when drinking unboiled water.
item.evolvedwarfare.tomato.desc: Eat it raw or in a stew. Seeds: one tomato in the crafting grid.
item.evolvedwarfare.corn.desc: Roast it in a furnace or on a campfire. Kernels (seeds): one cob in the crafting grid.
item.evolvedwarfare.cabbage.desc: Grows in autumn and winter. Seeds: one cabbage in the crafting grid.
item.evolvedwarfare.garlic.desc: Plant the garlic itself. Eating it cures parasites.
item.evolvedwarfare.vegetable_stew.desc: Very filling, warms you up and quenches thirst.
tooltip.evolvedwarfare.crop.indoors: Out of season, only under a roof and slowly
item.evolvedwarfare.fur_pelt.desc: Warm: use it for fur clothing (instead of wool) or turn it into leather. The furrier pays well for it.
item.evolvedwarfare.antler.desc: Trophy from deer, moose and reindeer. Ground into bone meal; the furrier buys it.
item.evolvedwarfare.horn.desc: From bison, mouflon and gazelles. Ground into bone meal; the furrier buys it.
item.evolvedwarfare.tusk.desc: From wild boars. Ground into bone meal; the furrier buys it.
item.evolvedwarfare.bear_claw.desc: Brown bear trophy. The furrier pays a lot for it.
message.evolvedwarfare.dismember.right_a: You cut off their right arm!
message.evolvedwarfare.dismember.left_ar: You cut off their left arm!
message.evolvedwarfare.dismember.right_l: You cut off their right leg!
message.evolvedwarfare.dismember.left_le: You cut off their left leg!
message.evolvedwarfare.dismember.head: DECAPITATED!
config.evolvedwarfare.dismemberment.tip: Edged weapons can cut off NPCs' arms and legs and, with luck, behead them.

message.evolvedwarfare.faucet.dry: No water comes out (no intake, or it needs pumping?)
config.evolvedwarfare.realisticFluids.ti: Water and lava are neither created nor destroyed: a block holds 25 layers and a bucket carries 4, which spread out, taking water lowers the lake. Oceans, rivers and swamps are infinite.
message.evolvedwarfare.infection: A zombie bit you: you are infected (milk cures it)
message.evolvedwarfare.infection.worse: Another bite: the infection gets worse (milk cures it)
death.attack.evolvedwarfare.infection.pl: %1$s died of an infection whilst fighting %2$s
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.today: Day %s: a zombie horde comes tonight. Get ready.
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.come: Here they come! A horde of %s zombies knows where you are.

config.evolvedwarfare.zombieHordeEveryDa: That day the counter turns green and a zombie horde comes at nightfall (0 = never).
config.evolvedwarfare.zombieHordeSize.ti: Grows by one each zombie night (up to double) and 5 more per extra player.
They break, dig and make their way to you (up to obsidian, given time). mobGriefing must be on too.
config.evolvedwarfare.zombieInfectionCha: Chance that a zombie's hit infects you.
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.0: You hear the dead rising from their graves...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.1: The earth cracks: something crawls out from below...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.2: A distant moan breaks the silence of the night...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.5: Something drags its feet in the dark...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.7: You hear nails scratching at the soil...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.11: A procession of corpses is coming for you...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.14: Those you buried do not rest...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.15: The moon lights up walking bodies...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.16: Clumsy footsteps close in from every side...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.18: Flesh tears somewhere in the distance...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.20: Bar the door: they are coming...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.21: The silence breaks into a choir of moans...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.22: Rotting hands rise out of the mud...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.24: The fog carries the smell of the grave...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.27: They feel your warmth from afar...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.28: The dead do not sleep tonight...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.30: The darkness moves on its own...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.31: Something pounds the earth from within...
message.evolvedwarfare.zombies.phrase.34: The stench of death draws near...
item.evolvedwarfare.lemonade.desc: Quenches a lot of thirst and cools you down. Boiled water, a lemon and sugar.
item.evolvedwarfare.orange_juice.desc: Quenches thirst and feeds you. A bottle and two oranges.
item.evolvedwarfare.pear.desc: Sweet and juicy. From the pear tree.
item.evolvedwarfare.plum.desc: Small and sweet. From the plum tree.
item.evolvedwarfare.peach.desc: Juicy and filling. From the peach tree.
item.evolvedwarfare.lemon.desc: Too sour to eat alone: better as lemonade. From the lemon tree.
item.evolvedwarfare.orange.desc: Sweet and thirst-quenching. From the orange tree.
config.evolvedwarfare.axeForLogs.tip: Logs can't be broken by hand or with other tools.
config.evolvedwarfare.treeFelling.tip: Chopping one of the two lowest logs fells the whole tree (sneak to take only that log).
commands.evolvedwarfare.zombies.started: A horde of %s zombies is coming for you
item.evolvedwarfare.brimstone.desc: Burns a long time in a furnace. With coal, gunpowder.
message.evolvedwarfare.fire_rain.start: Fire and brimstone rain from the sky! Take cover.
config.evolvedwarfare.fireRain.tip: Now and then fire falls from the Nether sky: it burns whatever is out in the open.
config.evolvedwarfare.fireRainEveryMinut: Minutes, roughly, between one fire rain and the next.
death.attack.evolvedwarfare.soul_touch: %1$s had their soul torn out by a lost soul
message.evolvedwarfare.demon.unharmed: Your weapon does nothing: only a weapon with Divine Blessing can harm a demon
message.evolvedwarfare.legion.split: "My name is Legion, for we are many"
item.evolvedwarfare.bait.desc: In your off hand while fishing: the green zone is bigger. One is used per fish.
item.evolvedwarfare.magic_bait.desc: Like bait, but better: an even bigger green zone, more chests, and it attracts big fish.
tooltip.evolvedwarfare.fish.mailbox: Can only be sold in the Sales Mailbox
message.evolvedwarfare.fishing.treasure: You fished up a treasure chest!
message.evolvedwarfare.fishing.level: Fishing level %s! The green zone is bigger.
config.evolvedwarfare.fishingMinigame.ti: When a fish bites, a minigame appears (like Stardew Valley); fish have weight and quality.

item.evolvedwarfare.carp.desc: A calm lake fish, one of the easiest; big ones are heavy.
item.evolvedwarfare.trout.desc: Cold fresh water; moves in jerks.
item.evolvedwarfare.pike.desc: A river predator: fast and treacherous.
item.evolvedwarfare.eel.desc: In swamps (and at night, in any fresh water); hides at the bottom.
item.evolvedwarfare.tuna.desc: From the deep sea. Huge and strong.
item.evolvedwarfare.swordfish.desc: Warm seas. Very rare and very hard: jumps like mad.
item.evolvedwarfare.sturgeon.desc: A rare river giant; pulls to the bottom.

manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.title: Smith's Manual
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.subtitle: The art of forging weapons and tools
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.intro.ste: Melt red-hot ingots in a crucible over a fire.
Carve a clay mold and pour the metal.
Sharpen the part on the anvil and fit it.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.intro.a: Iron, gold and diamond tools and weapons are no longer crafted at the table: they are cast and forged. Your hands set their quality.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.intro.b: Wood, stone, the flint axe, netherite and armor work as always.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.heat.a: An iron or gold ingot comes out red-hot from the blast furnace (5 s) or the furnace (10 s).
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.heat.b: Then into the crucible: each part takes 1 to 4 ingots.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.cool.a: The red-hot ingot smokes and cools after a minute: it turns back into a normal ingot.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.cool.b: Forge it before then. If it cools, put it back in the furnace.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.hammer.a: 2 iron ingots and 2 sticks at the table. Just carry it; it wears a little with each part.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.anvil.a: With the rough part in hand and the hammer on you, right-click an anvil.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.anvil.b: If it is iron and you carry diamonds, you can give it a diamond edge: one per ingot.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.game.a: The hammer slides back and forth. Strike (click or space) when it is over the orange; in the yellow center, perfect.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.strikes.a: Each part takes 4 to 9 strikes. After each one the zone moves and the hammer speeds up.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.strikes.b: The ingot cools (the red bar): if it cools down, the strikes left are misses.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.strikes.c: Gold is soft: easier to forge.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.parts.han: Handle: %s stick and a grip (leather or string)
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.parts.a: What each one costs. Hover over it to see its handle.
At the table, the part and its handle, anywhere: sticks and, for blades, a leather or string grip; for the flail, a chain.
Medieval weapons are not made of gold.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.quality.a: It comes from the mold, the pour and the sharpening. The tool keeps it, also when upgraded to netherite.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.level.a: It rises as you forge, from 0 to 10; the higher, the bigger the good zone.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.level.b: Practice with cheap parts (shovel, dagger, spear) before the big ones.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.level.c: City armorers sell this manual for 20 Glory Coins.
tooltip.evolvedwarfare.forged_part.rough: Sharpen it on the anvil with the hammer
tooltip.evolvedwarfare.crucible.empty: Put it over a fire and add red-hot ingots
message.evolvedwarfare.crucible.wrong_mo: That metal doesn't fit this mold
5 bricks. Put it over a campfire, fire, lava or magma and add red-hot ingots (up to 4): they melt.
Pick it up with an empty hand, metal and all. Away from the fire it cools in 30 s.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.mold.a: A water bottle, a clay ball and a stick. Place it on the ground: the wheel of parts opens.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.carve.a: Pick the part and carve its outline: left click scrapes, right click fills.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.carve.b: The clay dries: hurry. Scraping too much counts against you.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.pour.a: Crucible in hand, hold right click on the mold. The stream speeds up: let go at the line.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.pour.b: Green is perfect; too little leaves it incomplete; too much spills.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.crack.a: The metal sets and cools (don't touch it: it burns). Then, three hits by hand.
manual.evolvedwarfare.smithing.crack.b: Out comes the rough part: it still needs sharpening.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.fever: The lake's heat consumes you: you have a fever.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.bones: The ground creaks beneath your feet...
death.attack.evolvedwarfare.judgement: %1$s burned under the heat of judgement
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.0: And the smoke of their torment rises for ever and ever.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.2: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.3: The fire that is never quenched.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.4: Salt and brimstone, all its land burned.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.7: You have been weighed in the balance...
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.9: From the abyss they rose like locusts.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.10: My name is Legion, for we are many.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.13: He was there when they fell.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.15: Wide is the gate and broad is the way.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.16: She became a pillar of salt.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.18: He who has ears, let him hear.
message.evolvedwarfare.hell.vision.19: It is not your hour yet...
message.evolvedwarfare.fallen.name: Fallen
message.evolvedwarfare.spirit.burned: The spirit threw your %s into the lava
item.evolvedwarfare.damned_spirit_spawn_: Spirit of the Damned Spawn Egg
item.evolvedwarfare.abyss_metal.desc: Dropped by greater locusts. Dark and cold.
item.evolvedwarfare.dark_feather.desc: From the wings of a fallen one.
item.evolvedwarfare.fallen_armor_shard.d: A piece of armor that was once glorious.
item.evolvedwarfare.blessed_salt.desc: Purifies: frees a spirit of the damned, or use it to remove corruption and a curse.
item.evolvedwarfare.book_of_condemnation: Reading it hurts... but it reveals.
blade.evolvedwarfare.wrath.desc: Sets fire to what it wounds. Sometimes, to you the heat of judgement.
blade.evolvedwarfare.plague.desc: Poisons and withers. It makes you hungry.
blade.evolvedwarfare.silence.desc: Blinds what it wounds. Sometimes it blinds you.
blade.evolvedwarfare.fall.desc: Hits very hard and throws far. Every blow costs you life.
message.evolvedwarfare.altar.curse: The idol looks at you... and curses you.
message.evolvedwarfare.altar.refused: The idol does not want that.
message.evolvedwarfare.throne.deaths: The throne does not know you (you have fallen %s of %s times in this realm).
message.evolvedwarfare.throne.open: The throne knows you: something opens beneath the dais.
message.evolvedwarfare.condemnation.reve: The book shows you the way: %s, %s blocks to the %s.
message.evolvedwarfare.condemnation.weak: The book speaks the names: nearby lords of the abyss weaken.
message.evolvedwarfare.condemnation.noth: The pages are blank to you.
message.evolvedwarfare.sword.pulled: You pull the sword. It still glows: %s
vision.evolvedwarfare.0: an empty throne in a lake of fire
vision.evolvedwarfare.1: a black stone city sunk in lava
vision.evolvedwarfare.2: a field of wings stuck in the dust
vision.evolvedwarfare.3: a bottomless pit and, below, a sealed door
vision.evolvedwarfare.5: a mountain of sulfur burning inside
vision.evolvedwarfare.7: a green world, far, far away
lore.evolvedwarfare.0.title: The tower
lore.evolvedwarfare.0.0: They wanted to reach heaven and heaven took their tongue. Now every stone speaks a different language.
lore.evolvedwarfare.0.1: At the top there is a door that leads nowhere. Sometimes, for an instant, it does.
lore.evolvedwarfare.1.title: The fallen
lore.evolvedwarfare.1.0: They did not fall at once. They fell for nine days and nine nights, and on arrival they no longer remembered the light.
lore.evolvedwarfare.1.1: Do not look into their eyes. What remains in them blinds.
lore.evolvedwarfare.2.title: The cities of the plain
lore.evolvedwarfare.2.0: Brimstone and fire rained down. Whoever looked back stayed there, made of salt, looking forever.
lore.evolvedwarfare.2.1: The statues do not move while someone watches them. Never be alone among them.
lore.evolvedwarfare.3.title: The bottomless pit
lore.evolvedwarfare.3.0: The pit was opened and smoke rose like from a great furnace, and out of the smoke came locusts.
lore.evolvedwarfare.3.1: At the very bottom, under the fire, there are chambers someone sealed. Someone who was afraid.
lore.evolvedwarfare.4.title: Abaddon
lore.evolvedwarfare.4.0: His name is Destruction. He keeps a throne that is not his and waits for one who has died enough.
lore.evolvedwarfare.4.1: Three times one must fall in this realm for the throne to know you.
lore.evolvedwarfare.5.title: The false gods
lore.evolvedwarfare.5.0: The idols accept whatever you give them. Sometimes they return strength; sometimes, only their gaze.
lore.evolvedwarfare.5.1: Gold, bread, books, swords: they like everything. Nothing is enough.
lore.evolvedwarfare.6.title: The seals
lore.evolvedwarfare.6.0: There were seven. They broke them one by one, and for every broken seal a door opened.
lore.evolvedwarfare.6.1: Whoever gathers their pieces will be able to open what lies deepest.
lore.evolvedwarfare.7.title: The salt
lore.evolvedwarfare.7.0: Blessed salt keeps away those who steal. Cursed salt calls those who wait.
lore.evolvedwarfare.7.1: Mixed with gold and light, salt remembers what it was: purity.
lore.evolvedwarfare.8.title: The dry valley
lore.evolvedwarfare.8.0: Prophesy to these bones. But do not stand still among them: they hear.
lore.evolvedwarfare.8.1: The valley wind is not air: it is the breath of those waiting to rise.
lore.evolvedwarfare.9.title: A miner's diary
lore.evolvedwarfare.9.0: Day 40. The sulfur grows as if alive. Torches don't last. Juan says he hears the rock singing.
lore.evolvedwarfare.9.1: Day 41. We can't find Juan. We're leaving. We leave the tools: let the mountain keep them.
message.evolvedwarfare.altar.purified: The blessed salt burns on the altar: your curses come undone.

message.evolvedwarfare.ritual.purificati: Purification ritual: your curses come undone and a light protects you.
message.evolvedwarfare.ritual.dark_pact: Dark pact: the abyss lends you its strength... in exchange for you.
message.evolvedwarfare.ritual.seals: The seven seals melt together: the Key of the Abyss.
message.evolvedwarfare.ritual.consecrati: Consecration: the book burns with a white light.
message.evolvedwarfare.ritual.beast: The lake of fire boils... Something rises from the lava!
message.evolvedwarfare.ritual.prophet: A voice answers your call: "I am the one you were waiting for".
message.evolvedwarfare.ritual.need_nethe: This rite only has power in the Nether.
message.evolvedwarfare.ritual.need_lava: The Beast rises from lava: perform the rite beside a lake of fire.
message.evolvedwarfare.ritual.busy: There is already one like that nearby.

message.evolvedwarfare.angel.pit: "The pit has no bottom. Neither will you."
message.evolvedwarfare.prophet.altar: The False Prophet answers the offering...
message.evolvedwarfare.prophet.deceive: "What you hold is not what you think."
message.evolvedwarfare.prophet.illusions: "Which of us is the true one?"

message.evolvedwarfare.beast.healed: The Beast's mortal wound heals... and heads grow back!

rite.evolvedwarfare.consecration: Consecration: book + 2 blessed salt + gold block + a seal fragment
rite.evolvedwarfare.prophet: Call the prophet: gold block + written book + candle
rite.evolvedwarfare.beast: Wake the Beast: magma cream + blaze rod + fallen armor shard + book of condemnation (beside lava)
item.evolvedwarfare.backpack.desc: Right click: put it on. Sneak on the ground: place it like a chest. Dyeable.
container.evolvedwarfare.backpack_slot: Backpack (put it in the back slot)
container.evolvedwarfare.no_backpack: No backpack: you only carry 5 slots
message.evolvedwarfare.backpack.none: You are not wearing a backpack
item.evolvedwarfare.backpack.heavy: The last %s slots are heavy load: each one used slows you by %s %%
item.evolvedwarfare.flatcar.desc: Right click a train car to couple it at the back. Build on it with the building hammer.
message.evolvedwarfare.train.no_room: No room for another car (short track, moving train or 10 max)
message.evolvedwarfare.train.not_empty: Remove what's built before uncoupling the flatcar
message.evolvedwarfare.train.couple_hint: Couple it to a train: right click the locomotive or a car
item.evolvedwarfare.knife.desc: Right-click a downed animal to skin it
message.evolvedwarfare.skinning.need_kni: You need a knife in hand to skin it
config.evolvedwarfare.stackLimit.tip: How many stackable items fit in a slot: Standard (64), 100, 500, 1000 or 5000. Unstackable items (tools, armor) stay at one. On a server, the server's setting applies.
item.evolvedwarfare.prospector_pick.desc: Right-click rock: which mineral is nearby, how much and which way
message.evolvedwarfare.prospect.none: The rock sounds empty: no ore nearby
item.evolvedwarfare.steam_locomotive.des: Place it on a big track. Ride it: W and S, the throttle; space, the whistle. Sneak + right click: the firebox.
item.evolvedwarfare.coal_tender.desc: Right click a train car to couple it at the back. 27 coal slots for the locomotive.
item.evolvedwarfare.train_part.desc: Assembled at the train assembly table.
item.evolvedwarfare.building_hammer.desc: Right click: the building menu. Sneak + right click a piece: pick it up; a car: uncouple it.
item.evolvedwarfare.piece.desc: Aim at the train flatcar: green fits, red doesn't. Right click to place it.
gui.evolvedwarfare.build.title: Building
gui.evolvedwarfare.build.hint1: Hold the piece and aim at the flatcar:
gui.evolvedwarfare.build.hint2: green = fits. Sneak with hammer: pick up.
gui.evolvedwarfare.assembly.hint: Craft the parts at a crafting table.
message.evolvedwarfare.build.cant: Can't place it there (needs support or the spot is taken)
item.evolvedwarfare.track_straight.desc: Two wide, two long. Snaps to the nearest loose track end.
item.evolvedwarfare.track_slope.desc: Rises one block over four. Sneak to go down.
item.evolvedwarfare.track_switch_right.d: Straight and right curve; right click it to throw it.
item.evolvedwarfare.track_switch_left.de: Straight and left curve; right click it to throw it.
item.evolvedwarfare.atlas.desc: A live map of what you've explored, with structures, players and territories. Right click to open it.
gui.evolvedwarfare.atlas.name: Territory name
gui.evolvedwarfare.atlas.hint: Drag to move, scroll to zoom
gui.evolvedwarfare.atlas.other_world: The Atlas only maps the Overworld
message.evolvedwarfare.atlas.bad_name: Give the territory a name (up to 32 letters)
message.evolvedwarfare.atlas.taken: Some of those chunks already belong to another territory
message.evolvedwarfare.atlas.unexplored: You can only claim what you've explored
message.evolvedwarfare.atlas.not_connect: The territory's chunks must touch each other
message.evolvedwarfare.atlas.too_many: That's over the per-player chunk limit (%2$s)
message.evolvedwarfare.atlas.no_coins: Not enough Glory Coins (%s per chunk)
config.evolvedwarfare.atlasClaimCost.tip: Glory Coins it costs to claim each territory chunk in the Atlas.
config.evolvedwarfare.atlasMaxChunks.tip: How many territory chunks each player can claim in total.
message.evolvedwarfare.villager.idle: %s has no job and no shop
config.evolvedwarfare.asyncFluids.tip: Finite water and lava movement is computed on the mod's worker threads (less lag). Turn it off if water behaves oddly.
message.evolvedwarfare.hire.coins: Hiring them takes %s Glory Coins as well as the contract.
chat.evolvedwarfare.greet_morning.2: The roosters are up, %1$s. Another day.
chat.evolvedwarfare.greet_evening.2: Sun's going down. I could eat a horse.
chat.evolvedwarfare.rain.1: What a downpour... soaked to the bone.
chat.evolvedwarfare.rain.2: Nobody can work in this rain.
chat.evolvedwarfare.rain.3: At least the fields will be grateful.
chat.evolvedwarfare.clear.2: Days like this make it worth getting up.
chat.evolvedwarfare.clear.3: Not a cloud, %1$s. Hope it lasts.
chat.evolvedwarfare.cold.1: Brrr... this cold gets into your bones.
chat.evolvedwarfare.hot.2: I'd give anything for a bit of rain.
chat.evolvedwarfare.danger.1: Did you see that earlier? I barely made it!
chat.evolvedwarfare.danger.2: There are more monsters around every day...
chat.evolvedwarfare.danger.3: I'm never going out at night again.
chat.evolvedwarfare.hurt.2: Look what they did to me, %1$s.
chat.evolvedwarfare.night.1: It's late. I'm off to bed.
chat.evolvedwarfare.family.2: I'll fix the roof tomorrow, I promise.
chat.evolvedwarfare.family.4: I saved you a piece of bread.
chat.evolvedwarfare.gossip_good.1: You know, %2$s helped me yesterday. Good people.
chat.evolvedwarfare.gossip_good.2: I love talking to %2$s, always brightens my day.
chat.evolvedwarfare.gossip_good.3: %2$s works harder than anyone in this town.
chat.evolvedwarfare.gossip_bad.2: I don't trust %2$s, can't say why.
chat.evolvedwarfare.guard.2: See anything odd on your rounds?
chat.evolvedwarfare.guard.4: I've got the north gate. You?
chat.evolvedwarfare.player.1: That stranger's been watching us a while...
chat.evolvedwarfare.player.2: They say strangers pay well for folk like us.
chat.evolvedwarfare.player.3: Who's that? Not from around here.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.grumpy.1: Everything's going from bad to worse.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.grumpy.3: In my day this never happened.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.fearful.1: Did you hear that? Something's out there.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.fearful.2: I don't like this silence one bit.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.fearful.3: They say there are bandits in the woods...
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.brave.1: Let the monsters come. I'll be waiting.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.brave.2: Someday I'll go see the world.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.brave.3: Yesterday I scared off a wolf with a stick.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.lazy.2: A nap, that's what I need.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.lazy.3: I'll do it tomorrow, not in the mood today.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.kind.1: If you need anything, %1$s, I'm here.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.kind.2: You look tired. Rest a little.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.kind.3: I brought soup to the neighbours today.
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.curious.1: Do you know what lies beyond the mountains?
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.curious.2: I wonder who built those ruins...
chat.evolvedwarfare.trait.curious.3: Why do you think the sky is blue, %1$s?
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.laborer.1: Hauled more sacks today than ever.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.farmer.1: The wheat's coming in nicely this year.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.farmer.2: The crows keep eating my seeds.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.baker.2: I'm up before anyone to bake.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.blacksmith.1: Chipped another blade on the anvil.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.blacksmith.2: I need more iron, the forge never stops.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.carpenter.2: Oak's the best wood, whatever they say.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.lumberjack.2: My arms ache from all that chopping.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.miner.1: It's sweltering down in the mine.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.miner.2: Thought I saw a diamond... just a rock.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.hunter.1: Found deer tracks by the river.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.shepherd.1: A sheep ran off on me again.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.tailor.1: Got orders for three winter cloaks.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.tailor.2: I'm running out of blue thread.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.mason.1: I built that wall, you know.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.mason.2: Stone never forgives a bad strike.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.innkeeper.1: The tavern was packed last night.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.innkeeper.2: Running out of ale, as always.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.merchant.2: Sold little today, nobody has coins.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.guard.2: The captain's got us all on watch.
chat.evolvedwarfare.work.mercenary.2: I've fought more battles than I remember.
chat.evolvedwarfare.reply.friendly.4: That's just what I was thinking.
chat.evolvedwarfare.reply.neutral.4: Hmm, I don't know what to say.
chat.evolvedwarfare.reply.rude.2: And why are you telling me?
chat.evolvedwarfare.reply.rude.4: I've no time for your nonsense.
chat.evolvedwarfare.reply.danger.1: I saw it too. What a fright.
chat.evolvedwarfare.reply.danger.2: We need to tell the guards.
chat.evolvedwarfare.reply.family.3: We'll talk about it over dinner.
chat.evolvedwarfare.reply.gossip_agree.2: That's what the whole town says.
Hey! Don't talk about %2$s like that.
Well, I don't see it that way.
chat.evolvedwarfare.close.friendly.1: Well, back to it. See you!
chat.evolvedwarfare.close.rude.3: Clearly there's no talking to you today.
chat.evolvedwarfare.hello.grumpy.2: Another stranger... just what we needed.
chat.evolvedwarfare.hello.grumpy.3: Out of my way, I'm busy.
chat.evolvedwarfare.hello.fearful.2: H-hello... you're not here to hurt us?
chat.evolvedwarfare.hello.night.1: It's no hour to be wandering, stranger.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.open.friendly.1: %1$s! Good to see you. What brings you here?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.open.friendly.2: Well, %1$s! Come in. How can I help?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.open.rude.2: I've nothing to say to you.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.open.rude.3: Make it quick, I haven't got all day.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.open.night.1: At this hour? Well... what is it?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.open.night.2: Shh, it's night. What do you want?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.hurt.1: Bad. Everything hurts. Hope I heal soon.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.hurt.2: I've had better days... look at these wounds.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.scared.1: My legs are still shaking. There were monsters!
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.scared.2: Heart in my mouth! Didn't you see the monsters?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.cheerful.2: Great! Can't complain about a thing.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.grumpy.1: Same as ever: bad. Everything's bad.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.grumpy.2: My back hurts, my neighbour snores and the soup was cold.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.fearful.1: Fine... I think. Heard anything strange out there?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.fearful.2: Calm, as long as it doesn't get dark.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.lazy.1: Tired. Very tired. Need anything else?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.lazy.2: Ready for a good long nap.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.kind.1: Very well, thanks for asking. And you?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.kind.2: Good. If you need anything, just say.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.curious.1: Fine, but tell me, where are you from? What have you seen?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.how.curious.2: Thinking about a thousand things, as usual.
Having breakfast. Can't function without it.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.doing.leisure.1: Resting a while in the square.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.doing.leisure.2: Chatting with the neighbours, I've worked enough.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.doing.hide.1: Hiding! Don't you see what's out there?
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.doing.patrol.1: On patrol. Someone has to keep watch.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.about.intro.1: My name is %1$s and I'm a %2$s.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.about.trait.chee: I like to laugh and look on the bright side.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.about.trait.grum: I don't like noise, or people, or much of anything.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.about.trait.fear: I'd rather stay out of trouble.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.about.trait.brav: I'm not afraid of anything or anyone.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.about.trait.lazy: I work just enough. Life's for enjoying.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.about.trait.kind: I like helping others however I can.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.about.trait.curi: I always want to know more: other lands, old ruins...
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.news.none.1: Nothing new, really. Same as ever here.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.news.none.2: Not much. Rain or no rain, that's the news.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.news.danger.1: Careful, monsters were prowling around here not long ago.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.news.people.1: There are about %1$s of us in town. Everyone knows everyone.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.hire.ask.1: Work for you? For %1$s, I'd consider it.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.hire.refuse.2: I'd sooner work for a zombie than for you.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.hire.no_contract: No deal without a recruitment contract.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.hire.done.1: Deal! I'm with you to the end.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.hire.done.2: All right, I'll follow you. Hope you pay well.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.gift.thanks.3: You didn't have to... but thanks!
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.gift.again.1: Thanks, but you already gave me something a moment ago.
dialogue.evolvedwarfare.title: Talk
